framework.name: OpenCV
framework.linkage: Official static opencv2.framework; iPhoneOS arm64 slice. Framework is supplied externally, not committed.

license_reference_scope: The official iOS binary archive contains no standalone license files. OpenCV same-version license/dependency references were copied from the separately verified OpenCV 4.12.0 Android SDK. This notice inventory does not claim every listed dependency is linked into the iOS app.
